audited_method.policy: Retrospective public-source reconstruction, not point-in-time investor-observable backtest. Later restatements permitted by research design, though this extract retains the original issuer values already present in v4.

population.excluded: none; every historically eligible Top 40 instrument remains

audited_method.features: Original 11-feature concept except analyst ratings absent and P/E replaced by earnings yield; sector retained as categorical, do not ordinal-code; selected numeric fields preserve native units. Revenue/EPS may not have cross-sector uniform accounting meaning.

fundamental_imputation.method: training medians for modelling features only; raw values remain blank
fundamental_imputation.affected: RNI at all three snapshots; do not interpret imputed values as reported figures or as an ordinary cluster transition

audited_method.sector: Legacy Listcorp labels; eight categories, historically unverified. Categorical feature retained per user; do not call current official 11-industry ICB.
audited_method.shares_and_cap: All shares are unverified Yahoo-era historical reconstruction; cap reconciles as close times shares. No guarantee this share basis was available at snapshot.
audited_method.market: Retrospective Yahoo daily history with repairs documented in PIT Market, not an archived as-of vendor extract.
audited_method.permitted_use: Exploratory clustering, sensitivity analysis, pipeline development. Not no-look-ahead headline portfolio performance.
